description:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber 10
    participant UI@{ "type": "boundary" }
    participant Ctl@{ "type": "control" }
    participant Db@{ "type": "database" }
    participant Q@{ "type": "queue" }
    UI->>Ctl: submit
    Ctl->>Db: save
    create participant Job
    Ctl->>Job: start
    Job->>Q: enqueue
    destroy Job
    Job-->>Ctl: done
    Note over UI,Ctl: saved
name: Sequence diagram

description:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Ready
    state Ready {
        [*] --> Idle
        Idle --> Typing : key
        --
        [*] --> Offline
        Offline --> Online : connect
    }
    Ready --> split
    state split <<fork>>
    split --> Save
    split --> Sync
    state merge <<join>>
    Save --> merge
    Sync --> merge
    merge --> ok
    state ok <<choice>>
    ok --> [*] : fine
    ok --> Ready : retry
    note right of Save : writes to disk
name: State diagram
